escalations.why: risk.Drawdown in docs/packages/risk/contract.md is (ticker, depth, peak_date) with no trough_date, but RISK-05 ('the date of that peak and the date of the trough'), REP-01 ('RISK-05's drawdown ... and both dates') and the TC-08 oracle (tests/fixtures/risk/TC-08/expected.json carries trough_date; M1-T20 acceptance: 'both dates exact') all need it. Freezing the type as written leaves M1-T10/M1-T20 unable to meet their requirements. Proposed Revise: add 'trough_date: str' to risk.Drawdown (invariant: peak_date <= trough_date; both the first date when there is no fall).
